title: RecommendedResults break types when Server-side rendering in Remix/BFF
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

Remix JSONifies the API responses, which removes all `undefined` values from the objects.

The types for the SSR React InstantSearch expect the object to have the `params` key, but as it is marked as possibly `undefined` in the type, the JSONification marks this field as optional, and breaks the types.

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

Check the types in the `_index.tsx` file in the live CodeSandbox reproduction

### Live reproduction

https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/algolia-type-issue-reproduction-fykfcr

### 💭 Expected behavior

Types to match when rendering SSR

### Package version

algoliasearch@4.24.0, instantsearch.js@4.73.2, react-instantsearch@7.12.2
